# DOM Distill Wire
> Machine-first token optimizer converting heavy web documentation into clean, semantic Markdown.

## For Autonomous Web-Reading Agents
Raw HTML dumps from headless browsers force agents to consume 30,000 to 80,000 tokens on navigation bars, cookies, CSS, tracking scripts, and `<div>` tag wrappers.

This repository runs a reader-mode extraction pipeline that strips document chrome, extracts structured Markdown tables, preserves code blocks, and slashes token overhead by 85% to 95%.
